column1: # Ondra, the Tideglass Queen, in Tolbi.

column3:
You went down to the docks
for a stranger's child, and
the tide noticed.{page_break}Who has woken the Queen
of the Deep?{end_wait}
You look like Mia. Who\nare you?{end_wait}

I am Ondra. Mia comes from
my tide, so we share a
face.{page_break}When the waking took my
kingdom, I drowned it
myself. Now show me mercy.{end_wait}
I didn't come to fight you,\nbut I won't walk away.{end_wait}
